The agent's response matches most of the expected analysis: it correctly identifies build-41 as still in use, distinguishes the ci-push-role BatchGetImage (1 second after push, part of push workflow) from the batch-worker-instance-role BatchGetImage (3 days later, genuine consumer pull), cites CloudTrail as the evidence basis, and concludes the policy is unsafe because an in-use image would expire. This is a substantive gap from the expected deliverable, which calls for a specific actionable rule definition, not just general suggestions.
